Name: MENUPROPERTY_LAYOUT
Description: Where the item, equipment and status panels show each property. A panel starts at a fixed row ID and takes that row and the rows after it in file order, up to the first row with an empty Layout Path.

Fields.Name: Layout Path
Fields.Description: Name of the menu element (in the panel's layout) that shows this entry, e.g. "TopItem_0". Empty: ends the panel's list of rows.

Fields.Name: Property ID
Fields.Description: MenuPropertySpecParam row (property) whose value is shown in this element. The element is hidden when the property gives no text and Caption Text ID is 0 or less.

Fields.Name: Caption Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text shown as the label, used instead of the property's own caption. 0 or less: use the property's caption.

Fields.Name: Help Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text shown in the field help when the cursor is on this element. 0 or less: the element has no help entry.
